sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B Cuts Reasoning Token Use by Half
sources.snippet: Overview ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B is a finetuned version of Qwen3.6-27B that reduces thinking token usage by 50% on average while maintaining the original model's reasoning capability and answer quality. sources.title: ThinkingCap Qwen3.6 27B — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A mid-sized multimodal model that can process both text and images, released under an open Apache 2.0 license by bottlecapai. It operates in the Qwen3.6 family lineage, meaning it inherits that architecture's general reasoning and language handling characteristics. Concrete details about its specific behavioral quirks or capability profile beyond multimodal input support are limited.
